draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.33, the 54th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 6th of 30 at LB. He went 30th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Samson Ebukam. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (98th percentile), 10-yard split (92nd percentile), vertical jump (98th percentile). College production: 18 tackles in 2022, 30th of 30 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Philadelphia Eagles. 45 career games and 22 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 6 AV in 2025 against a career-best 6 in 2024. Weak spots: tackles for loss 1 (17th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 edge rusher who played: 3.0 sacks against a median of 2.0, above the norm.
